variable_parameters.name: commanded_approach_speed
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: requested ego m/s, not a measured speeding finding

variable_parameters.name: requested_following_encounters
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: one or two requested lead closing segments

variable_parameters.name: path_length_m
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: continuous original driving path in m

variable_parameters.name: following_time_gap_s
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: original ego/lead body spacing divided by observed ego speed, no legal cutoff

variable_parameters.name: hazard_conflict_geometry
variable_parameters.range_or_domain: original person/vehicle body positions and velocities
